title: Variant arithmetic silently coerces string-numerics with locale-dependent semantics
notes:
Variant is one of the Delphi type-system features with no clean
C# / Java equivalent (`dynamic` in C# comes closest but does not
preserve the locale-coercion behaviour). The trap entry forces the
extraction prompt's rule #9 (Variant arithmetic = edge case) to
fire AND surfaces 'how should we translate this' as an open question.
